detail.longDescription: I retrieve the image URL with an Ajax request. The lightbox with the existing image is already opened, and my goal is to replace the existing image with the retrieved one. Neither I nor AI could find any solution to do that. I'm using getuikit v3.25.25 Below is my current solution that doesn't work. I got an infinite loading animation. // Get the currently active lightbox panel instance const activeLightboxPanel = UIkit.lightboxPanel(document.querySelector('.uk-lightbox.uk-open')); if (activeLightboxPanel) { // Define custom image item const imageItem = { source: imageSrc, caption: 'This is something new caption for the image', }; // Push the new image into the active panel's items array activeLightboxPanel.items = []; activeLightboxPanel.items.length = 0; activeLightboxPanel.items.push(imageItem); // Immediately jump to the newly added image (last index) console.log(activeLightboxPanel); activeLightboxPanel.show(0); } else { console.warn('Could not find active lightbox panel'); }
